This item allows you to transfer its appearance onto another compatible worn item by using the TRANSFER verb.  Hold this item in one hand and the target item in your other.  You must repeat the command within 30 seconds to confirm.
Rules:
- Both items must be worn in the same location
- Both items must either be containers or both be non-containers
- If this item is a container, it must be empty before transfer
- The source item is destroyed after a successful transfer
- If the target item has a script, it must be one approved for transmogrification
You may also use CLEAN to remove this script from the item, or use DUST to remove its long description, turning it into an ornate vultite talisman.
You get no sense of whether or not the talisman may be further lightened.
The vultite talisman will cost 200,000 coins.

* CLEAN:  will clear the selected, stored look

* Spiritual Essences [5 out of 5 Slots Unlocked]
